2026 Adjustments of Relocation Assistance Payments
Annual increases for owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments go into effect January 1, 2026.

At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.
The standard relocation assistance payment will increase to
$19,413
.
The additional relocation assistance payment for qualifying households will increase to
$6,471
.
